WITH
stockinfor AS 
(
        SELECT
                symbol
                , symbolisin 
                , tradingdate 
                , stocktype 
                , ds_etl_pcs_tms 
        FROM (
                SELECT
                        js.symbol
                        , js.symbolisin 
                        , js.tradingdate 
                        , js.stocktype 
                        , js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
                        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate 
                                ORDER BY js.tradingtime DESC
                        ) AS rn
                FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js 
                WHERE 1=1
                        AND TO_DATE(js.ds_etl_pcs_tms) = TO_DATE('2026-09-18', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
                        AND js.stocktype IN (1, 2, 3)
        ) t
        WHERE t.rn = 1
)
,cte as 
(
select
          SUM(CASE WHEN buy_foreigner_investor_type <> '00' THEN Execution_Value ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sell_foreigner_investor_type  <> '00' THEN Execution_Value ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_ban,
   SUM(Execution_Value) tong_gtri
FROM
        uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
join 
        stockinfor js on tb.symbol = js.symbol and tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate 
where
        tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        and to_date(tb.ds_snpst_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_date('2026-09-07', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
union all
select
    SUM(CASE WHEN Buy_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10','20') THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Sell_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10','20') THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_ban,
    SUM(Trade_price * Trade_quantity) tong_gtri
FROM
        uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb 
join 
        stockinfor js on js.symbolisin = tb.issue_code and to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = js.tradingdate 
WHERE
        tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        and to_date(tb.ds_snpst_dt) = to_date('2026-09-07', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
)
--tỷ lệ tham gia

    join stockinfor js on tb.symbol = js.symbol and tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate 
--                    and to_date(js.ds_etl_pcs_tms) =  to_date('20260908','yyyyMMdd') 
    WHERE         tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
--    and ds_snpst_dt = to_date('20260908','yyyyMMdd')
    UNION ALL
    -- 2. Sàn HNX
    SELECT 
        'HNX'                                                    AS exchange,
        to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd')                          AS trade_date,
        tb.issue_code                                               AS symbol,
        tb.trade_price * tb.trade_quantity             AS execution_value,
        CASE WHEN tb.buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN tb.trade_price * tb.trade_quantity ELSE 0.0 END AS gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        CASE WHEN tb.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN tb.trade_price * tb.trade_quantity ELSE 0.0 END AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
    FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb

,

    SELECT 
        t.exchange,
        t.trade_date,
        t.symbol,
        coalesce(c.industry_name, 'Chưa phân ngành')  AS industry_name,
        t.execution_value,
        t.gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        t.gtri_ndtnn_ban
    FROM raw_trades t
    JOIN uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp 
           ON t.symbol = cp.equity_ticker 
          AND cp.ds_snpst_dt = to_date('2026-09-02')
    LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.categories c 
           ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id and c.ds_snpst_dt = to_date('2026-09-02')
),
daily_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        trade_date,
        sum(gtri_ndtnn_mua)  AS gtri_mua_ngay,
        sum(gtri_ndtnn_ban)  AS gtri_ban_ngay,
        sum(execution_value) AS tong_gtgd_ngay,
        round(
            ((sum(gtri_ndtnn_mua) + sum(gtri_ndtnn_ban)) / 
             case when sum(execution_value) * 2 = 0 then null else sum(execution_value) * 2 end) * 100, 
            4
        ) AS ty_trong_ngay_pct
    FROM base_trades
    GROUP BY trade_date
)
SELECT 
    sum(gtri_mua_ngay) - sum(gtri_ban_ngay)                          AS luy_ke_mua_rong
FROM daily_summary;

			, js.stocktype 
			, js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
			, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
				PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate

			) AS rn
		FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js 
		WHERE 1=1
			AND TO_DATE(js.ds_etl_pcs_tms) = TO_DATE('2026-09-18', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
			AND js.stocktype IN (1, 2, 3)
	) t
	WHERE t.rn = 1
),
raw_trades AS (
-- 1. Sàn HOSE
    SELECT 
        'HOSE'                                                   AS exchange,
    	to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')                        AS trade_date,
        tb.symbol                                                    AS symbol,

        CASE WHEN tb.buy_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN tb.execution_value ELSE 0.0 END   AS gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        CASE WHEN tb.sell_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN tb.execution_value ELSE 0.0 END   AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
    FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
    join stockinfor js on tb.symbol = js.symbol and tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate 
--    		and to_date(js.ds_etl_pcs_tms) =  to_date('20260908','yyyyMMdd') 
    WHERE 	tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
    and ds_snpst_dt = to_date('20260907','yyyyMMdd')
    UNION ALL
    -- 2. Sàn HNX
    SELECT 
        'HNX'                                                    AS exchange,
        to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd')                          AS trade_date,
        tb.issue_code                                               AS symbol,
        tb.trade_price * tb.trade_quantity             AS execution_value,
        CASE WHEN tb.buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN tb.trade_price * tb.trade_quantity ELSE 0.0 END AS gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        CASE WHEN tb.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN tb.trade_price * tb.trade_quantity ELSE 0.0 END AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
    FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb
    join stockinfor js on js.symbolisin = tb.issue_code and to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = js.tradingdate 
    WHERE 	tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
    and tb.ds_snpst_dt = to_date('20260907','yyyyMMdd')
),
stock_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        coalesce(c.industry_name, 'Chưa phân ngành')             AS industry_name,
        sum(t.gtri_ndtnn_mua)                                    AS gtri_mua_nganh,
        sum(t.gtri_ndtnn_ban)                                    AS gtri_ban_nganh,
        sum(t.gtri_ndtnn_mua) - sum(t.gtri_ndtnn_ban)            as mua_ban_rong
    FROM raw_trades t
    LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp 
           ON t.symbol = cp.equity_ticker 
          AND cp.ds_snpst_dt = to_date('2026-09-02')
    LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.categories c 
           ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id
           AND c.ds_snpst_dt = to_date('2026-09-02')
    GROUP BY coalesce(c.industry_name, 'Chưa phân ngành')
)
SELECT 
    industry_name              		AS nganh,
	sum(mua_ban_rong)				as mua_ban_rong
FROM stock_agg
group by industry_name
having mua_ban_rong < 0
ORDER BY mua_ban_rong asc
limit 5;

WITH
stockinfor AS 
(
	SELECT
		symbol
		, symbolisin 
		, tradingdate 
		, stocktype 
		, ds_etl_pcs_tms 
	FROM (
		SELECT
			js.symbol
			, js.symbolisin 
			, js.tradingdate 
			, js.stocktype 
			, js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
			, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
				PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate 
				ORDER BY js.tradingtime DESC
			) AS rn
		FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js 
		WHERE 1=1
			AND TO_DATE(js.ds_etl_pcs_tms) = TO_DATE('2026-09-18', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
			AND js.stocktype IN (1, 2, 3)
	) t
	WHERE t.rn = 1
),
raw_trades AS (
    SELECT 
        tb.symbol  as symbol,
        to_date(trade_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')                        AS trade_date,
        execution_value                          AS execution_value,
        CASE WHEN buy_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN execution_value ELSE 0.0 END   AS gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        CASE WHEN sell_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN execution_value ELSE 0.0 END   AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
    FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
    join stockinfor js on tb.symbol = js.symbol and tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate 
--                    and to_date(js.ds_etl_pcs_tms) =  to_date('20260908','yyyyMMdd') 
    WHERE         tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
--    and ds_snpst_dt = to_date('20260908','yyyyMMdd')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        tb.issue_code as symbol,
        to_date(trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd')                          AS trade_date,
        trade_price * trade_quantity             AS execution_value,
        CASE WHEN buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN trade_price * trade_quantity ELSE 0.0 END AS gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        CASE WHEN sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20') 
             THEN trade_price * trade_quantity ELSE 0.0 END AS gtri_ndtnn_ban
    FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb
    join stockinfor js on tb.issue_code = js.symbol and tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate 
--                    and to_date(js.ds_etl_pcs_tms) =  to_date('20260908','yyyyMMdd') 
    WHERE         tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
--    and ds_snpst_dt = to_date('20260908','yyyyMMdd')
),
stock_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        coalesce(c.industry_name, 'Chưa phân ngành')             AS industry_name,
        sum(t.gtri_ndtnn_mua)                                    AS gtri_mua_ma,
        sum(t.gtri_ndtnn_ban)                                    AS gtri_ban_ma,
        sum(t.gtri_ndtnn_mua) + sum(t.gtri_ndtnn_ban)            AS tong_gtgd_ndtnn_ma,
        sum(t.execution_value)                                   AS tong_gtgd_ma
    FROM raw_trades t
    LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp 
           ON t.symbol = cp.equity_ticker 
          AND cp.ds_snpst_dt = to_date('2026-09-02')
    LEFT JOIN uat_ids_stg.categories c 
           ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id
    GROUP BY coalesce(c.industry_name, 'Chưa phân ngành')
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
        (tong_gtgd_ndtnn_ma / 
         (tong_gtgd_ma*2)) * 100 AS ty_trong_nganh_pct
FROM stock_agg
ORDER BY ty_trong_nganh_pct DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH base_cell AS (
    SELECT
        report_log_id,
        section_id,
        row_path,
        row_order,
        entity_code,
        column_path,
        value_raw,
        value_num,
        value_text
    FROM uat_fims_ods.fact_report_cell
    WHERE report_code IN ('59WJB', 'BZ5X4')
      AND sheet_name  = 'II'
      AND is_mirror = 0 
      AND is_section_echo = 0 
      AND is_band_overflow = 0
      AND is_static_copy = 0 
      AND is_template_marker = 0
      AND is_total_row = 0
      AND ngay_nop = :ngaynop
),
base_rows AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        report_log_id,
        section_id,
        row_path,
        row_order,
        entity_code
    FROM base_cell
),
c_ten_kh AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, COALESCE(value_text, value_raw) AS ten_kh
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Tên khách hàng'
),
c_loai_hinh AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, COALESCE(value_text, value_raw) AS loai_hinh_to_chuc
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Loại hình đối với tổ chức'
),
c_gtri_danh_muc AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, 
           COALESCE(value_num, CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(value_raw, "^'", "") AS DOUBLE)) AS tong_gtri_danh_muc
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Tổng giá trị danh mục > Giá trị'
),
pvt_data AS (
    SELECT
        b.row_path,
        b.row_order,
        b.entity_code,
        c_ten_kh.ten_kh,
        c_loai_hinh.loai_hinh_to_chuc,
        c_gtri_danh_muc.tong_gtri_danh_muc
    FROM base_rows b
    LEFT JOIN c_ten_kh        ON b.report_log_id = c_ten_kh.report_log_id        AND b.section_id = c_ten_kh.section_id        AND b.row_order = c_ten_kh.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_loai_hinh     ON b.report_log_id = c_loai_hinh.report_log_id     AND b.section_id = c_loai_hinh.section_id     AND b.row_order = c_loai_hinh.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_gtri_danh_muc ON b.report_log_id = c_gtri_danh_muc.report_log_id AND b.section_id = c_gtri_danh_muc.section_id AND b.row_order = c_gtri_danh_muc.row_order
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(loai_hinh_to_chuc, 'Cá nhân / Chưa xác định') AS loai_hinh_to_chuc,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN row_path = 'B-Cá nhân' THEN tong_gtri_danh_muc END), 4) AS tong_gtri_danh_muc_ca_nhan,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN row_path = 'A-Tổ chức' 
             AND (loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Công ty%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Ngân hàng%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Tổ chức%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Không phải quỹ%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Các loại khác%') 
        THEN tong_gtri_danh_muc
    END), 4) AS dong_von_rong_tochuc_khac_quy,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN row_path = 'A-Tổ chức' 
             AND loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Quỹ%' 
             AND loai_hinh_to_chuc NOT LIKE '%Không phải quỹ%' 
        THEN tong_gtri_danh_muc
    END), 4) AS dong_von_rong_quy
FROM pvt_data
WHERE tong_gtri_danh_muc IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(loai_hinh_to_chuc, 'Cá nhân / Chưa xác định');

      AND ngay_nop = :ngaynop

c_quoc_tich AS (
    SELECT 
        report_log_id, 
        section_id, 
        row_order, 
        COALESCE(value_text, value_raw) AS quoc_tich
    FROM base_cell
    WHERE column_path = 'Quốc tịch'
),
c_dong_von AS (
    SELECT 
        report_log_id, 
        section_id, 
        row_order, 
        COALESCE(value_num, CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(value_raw, "^'", "") AS DOUBLE)) AS dong_von_rong
    FROM base_cell
    WHERE column_path = 'Giá trị dòng vốn vào trong kỳ báo cáo (+/-) (đơn vị USD)'
)
SELECT 
    q.quoc_tich,
    ROUND(SUM(d.dong_von_rong), 4) AS vao_rong
FROM c_dong_von d
JOIN c_quoc_tich q 
    ON d.report_log_id = q.report_log_id 
   AND d.section_id    = q.section_id 
   AND d.row_order     = q.row_order
WHERE q.quoc_tich IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY q.quoc_tich
ORDER BY vao_rong ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH
stockinfor AS 
(
	SELECT
		symbol
		, symbolisin 
		, tradingdate 
		, stocktype 
		, ds_etl_pcs_tms 
	FROM (
		SELECT
			js.symbol
			, js.symbolisin 
			, js.tradingdate 
			, js.stocktype 
			, js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
			, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
				PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate 
				ORDER BY js.tradingtime DESC
			) AS rn
		FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor js 
		WHERE 1=1
			AND TO_DATE(js.ds_etl_pcs_tms) = TO_DATE('2026-09-18', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
			AND js.stocktype IN (1, 2, 3)
	) t
	WHERE t.rn = 1
)
,cte as 
(
select
          SUM(CASE WHEN buy_foreigner_investor_type <> '00' THEN Execution_Value ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sell_foreigner_investor_type  <> '00' THEN Execution_Value ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_ban,
   SUM(Execution_Value) tong_gtri
FROM
        uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
join 
        stockinfor js on tb.symbol = js.symbol and tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate 
where
        tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        and to_date(tb.ds_snpst_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_date('2026-09-07', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
union all
select
    SUM(CASE WHEN Buy_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10','20') THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Sell_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10','20') THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_ban,
    SUM(Trade_price * Trade_quantity) tong_gtri
FROM
        uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb 
join 
        stockinfor js on js.symbolisin = tb.issue_code and to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = js.tradingdate 
WHERE
        tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdatee1 AND :pdatee2
        and to_date(tb.ds_snpst_dt) = to_date('2026-09-07', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
)
--luỹ kế mua bán ròng
select SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua) - SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban) as luy_ke from cte;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        m.tradingdate,
        m.marketId,
        m.marketCode,
        m.marketIndex,
        m.indexTime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.marketId, m.marketCode, m.tradingdate

        -- Lọc khoảng ngày (nếu cần lọc, truyền dạng 'yyyyMMdd' ví dụ: '20260101'):

    marketId,
    marketCode,
    marketIndex,
    indexTime
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY tradingdate, marketId, marketCode;

        row_order,

    FROM base_cell 
    WHERE column_path = 'Tên khách hàng'
),
c_loai_hinh AS (
    SELECT 
        report_log_id, 
        section_id, 
        row_order, 
        COALESCE(value_text, value_raw) AS loai_hinh_to_chuc
    FROM base_cell 
    WHERE column_path = 'Loại hình đối với tổ chức'
),
c_gtri_danh_muc AS (
    SELECT 
        report_log_id, 
        section_id, 
        row_order, 
        -- Ưu tiên lấy value_num kiểu DOUBLE, nếu rỗng thì ép kiểu từ value_raw
        value_num AS tong_gtri_danh_muc
    FROM base_cell 
    WHERE column_path = 'Tổng giá trị danh mục > Giá trị'
),
pvt_data AS (
    SELECT
        b.row_path,
        b.row_order,
        b.entity_code,
        c_ten_kh.ten_kh,
        c_loai_hinh.loai_hinh_to_chuc,
        c_gtri_danh_muc.tong_gtri_danh_muc
    FROM base_rows b
    -- Khóa ghép kèm report_log_id để tránh nhân chéo dòng giữa 2 báo cáo 59WJB và BZ5X4:
    LEFT JOIN c_ten_kh        ON b.report_log_id = c_ten_kh.report_log_id 
                             AND b.section_id    = c_ten_kh.section_id 
                             AND b.row_order     = c_ten_kh.row_order

    LEFT JOIN c_loai_hinh     ON b.report_log_id = c_loai_hinh.report_log_id 
                             AND b.section_id    = c_loai_hinh.section_id 
                             AND b.row_order     = c_loai_hinh.row_order

    LEFT JOIN c_gtri_danh_muc ON b.report_log_id = c_gtri_danh_muc.report_log_id 
                             AND b.section_id    = c_gtri_danh_muc.section_id 
                             AND b.row_order     = c_gtri_danh_muc.row_order
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(loai_hinh_to_chuc, 'Cá nhân / Chưa xác định') AS loai_hinh_to_chuc,
    -- 1. Cá nhân
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN row_path = 'B-Cá nhân' 
        THEN tong_gtri_danh_muc 
    END), 4) AS tong_gtri_danh_muc_ca_nhan,   
    -- 2. Tổ chức khác Quỹ (Bọc ngoặc tròn các điều kiện OR để row_path = 'A-Tổ chức' áp dụng cho tất cả)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN row_path = 'A-Tổ chức' 
             AND (loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Công ty%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Ngân hàng%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Tổ chức%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Không phải quỹ%' 
                  OR loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Các loại khác%') 
        THEN tong_gtri_danh_muc
    END), 4) AS dong_von_rong_tochuc_khac_quy,
    -- 3. Quỹ
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN row_path = 'A-Tổ chức' 
             AND loai_hinh_to_chuc LIKE '%Quỹ%' 
             AND loai_hinh_to_chuc NOT LIKE '%Không phải quỹ%' 
        THEN tong_gtri_danh_muc
    END), 4) AS dong_von_rong_quy,
     sum(tong_gtri_danh_muc)
FROM pvt_data
WHERE tong_gtri_danh_muc IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(loai_hinh_to_chuc, 'Cá nhân / Chưa xác định');

),

    SELECT 
        report_log_id, 
        section_id, 
        row_order, 
        SUM(value_num) AS trai_phieu
    FROM base_cell 
    WHERE column_path IN (
        'Trái phiếu > Thời gian còn lại tới khi đáo hạn > Ngắn hạn > Dưới 12 tháng > Giá trị',
        'Trái phiếu > Thời gian còn lại tới khi đáo hạn > Trung hạn > Từ 12 tháng đến 24 tháng > Giá trị',
        'Trái phiếu > Thời gian còn lại tới khi đáo hạn > Dài hạn > Trên 24 tháng > Giá trị'
    )
    GROUP BY report_log_id, section_id, row_order
),
c_CCQ AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, 
           value_num AS ccq
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Cổ phiếu/Chứng chỉ quỹ > Cổ phiếu niêm yết, chứng chỉ quỹ niêm yết > Giá trị'
),
c_upcom AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, 
           value_num AS upcom
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Cổ phiếu/Chứng chỉ quỹ > Cổ phiếu công ty đại chúng đăng ký giao dịch (upcom) > Giá trị'
),
c_gtri_von_gop AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, 
           value_num AS gtri_von_gop
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Cổ phiếu/Chứng chỉ quỹ > Giá trị vốn góp mua cổ phần, quỹ thành viên và chứng khoán khác > Giá trị'
),
c_tien AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, 
           value_num AS tien
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Tiền và các khoản tương đương tiền (chứng chỉ tiền gửi...) > Giá trị'
),
c_gtri_danh_muc AS (
    SELECT report_log_id, section_id, row_order, 
           value_num AS tong_gtri_danh_muc
    FROM base_cell WHERE column_path = 'Tổng giá trị danh mục > Giá trị'
),
pvt_data AS (
    SELECT
        b.row_path,
        b.row_order,
        b.entity_code,
                c_tin_phieu.tin_phieu,
                c_trai_phieu.trai_phieu,
                c_CCQ.ccq,
                c_upcom.upcom,
                c_gtri_von_gop.gtri_von_gop,
                c_tien.tien,
        c_gtri_danh_muc.tong_gtri_danh_muc
    FROM base_rows b
    LEFT JOIN c_tin_phieu ON b.report_log_id = c_tin_phieu.report_log_id
            AND b.section_id = c_tin_phieu.section_id        
            AND b.row_order = c_tin_phieu.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_trai_phieu ON b.report_log_id = c_trai_phieu.report_log_id
            AND b.section_id = c_trai_phieu.section_id    
            AND b.row_order = c_trai_phieu.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_CCQ ON b.report_log_id = c_CCQ.report_log_id
            AND b.section_id = c_CCQ.section_id    
            AND b.row_order = c_CCQ.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_upcom ON b.report_log_id = c_upcom.report_log_id
            AND b.section_id = c_upcom.section_id    
            AND b.row_order = c_upcom.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_gtri_von_gop ON b.report_log_id = c_gtri_von_gop.report_log_id
            AND b.section_id = c_gtri_von_gop.section_id    
            AND b.row_order = c_gtri_von_gop.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_tien ON b.report_log_id = c_tien.report_log_id
            AND b.section_id = c_tien.section_id    
            AND b.row_order = c_tien.row_order
    LEFT JOIN c_gtri_danh_muc ON b.report_log_id = c_gtri_danh_muc.report_log_id 
            AND b.section_id = c_gtri_danh_muc.section_id 
            AND b.row_order = c_gtri_danh_muc.row_order
)
SELECT
        sum(tin_phieu)*100/sum(tong_gtri_danh_muc) as tin_phieu,
        sum(trai_phieu)*100/sum(tong_gtri_danh_muc) as trai_phieu,
        sum(ccq)*100/sum(tong_gtri_danh_muc) as ccq,
        sum(upcom)*100/sum(tong_gtri_danh_muc) as upcom,
        sum(gtri_von_gop)*100/sum(tong_gtri_danh_muc) as gtri_von_gop,
        sum(tien)*100/sum(tong_gtri_danh_muc) as tien
FROM pvt_data;

	SELECT
		symbol

		, stocktype

	FROM (
		SELECT
			js.symbol
			, js.symbolisin 
			, js.tradingdate 
			, js.stocktype 
			, js.ds_etl_pcs_tms
			, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
				PARTITION BY js.symbol, js.tradingdate

	) t

,cte as 
(
select
        SUM(case WHEN (tb.buy_foreigner_investor_type <> '00') and (js.stocktype = 1) THEN Execution_Value ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua_co_phieu,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (sell_foreigner_investor_type <> '00') and (js.stocktype = 1) THEN Execution_Value ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_ban_co_phieu,
        SUM(case WHEN (buy_foreigner_investor_type <> '00') and (js.stocktype = 2) THEN Execution_Value ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua_trai_phieu,
        SUM(case when (sell_foreigner_investor_type <> '00') and (js.stocktype = 2) then Execution_Value else 0 end) gtri_ndtnn_ban_trai_phieu,
        SUM(case WHEN (tb.buy_foreigner_investor_type <> '00') and (js.stocktype = 3) THEN tb.Execution_Value ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua_CCQ,
        SUM(case when (tb.sell_foreigner_investor_type <> '00') and (js.stocktype = 3) then tb.Execution_Value else 0 end) gtri_ndtnn_ban_CCQ
FROM
        uat_hose_stg.trade_book tb
left join 
        stockinfor js on tb.symbol = js.symbol and tb.trade_date = js.tradingdate 
where
        tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
--        and to_date(tb.ds_snpst_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_date('2026-09-07', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
union all
select
        SUM(CASE WHEN Buy_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10', '20') and (js.stocktype = 1) THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua_co_phieu,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Sell_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10', '20') and (js.stocktype = 1) THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_ban_co_phieu,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Buy_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10', '20') and (js.stocktype = 2) THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua_trai_phieu,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Sell_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10', '20') and (js.stocktype = 2) THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_ban_trai_phieu,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (Buy_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10', '20')) and (js.stocktype in(3,6)) THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_mua_CCQ,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (Sell_Foreign_Investor_Type_Code IN ('10', '20')) and (js.stocktype in(3,6)) THEN (Trade_price * Trade_quantity) ELSE 0 END) gtri_ndtnn_ban_CCQ
FROM
        uat_hnx_stg.trade_book tb 
left join 
        stockinfor js on js.symbolisin = tb.issue_code and to_date(tb.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') = js.tradingdate 
WHERE
        tb.trade_date BETWEEN :pdat1 AND :pdat2
        and to_date(tb.ds_snpst_dt) = to_date('2026-09-07', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
)

select
        SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua_co_phieu)     AS tong_gtri_ndtnn_mua_co_phieu,

        SUM(gtri_ndtnn_mua_co_phieu) - SUM(gtri_ndtnn_ban_co_phieu) as luy_ke_co_phieu
FROM cte;

SELECT
ROWNUM AS stt,
inv."Name" AS ho_ten_ndt,
inv."EName" AS ho_ten_ndt_en,
CASE inv."ObjectType" WHEN 1 THEN 'Ca nhan'
WHEN 2 THEN 'To chuc' END AS loai_hinh,
inv."TransactionCode" AS ma_so_giao_dich,
nat."Name" AS quoc_tich,
inv."Address" AS dia_chi,
tr."FULLNAME" AS ten_dai_dien_gd,
it."Name" AS loai_hinh_ndt_to_chuc,
cs."SecId" AS ma_chung_khoan,
cs."Quantity" AS so_luong_so_huu,
cs."Rate" AS ty_le_so_huu_pct
FROM FIMS_NEW.INVESTOR inv
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.NATIONAL nat ON nat."Id" = inv."NaId" AND nat."Deleted"   = 0
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.INVESTORTYPE it ON it."Id" = inv."InvestorTypeId" AND it."Deleted" = 0
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.CATEGORIESSTOCK cs ON cs."InvesId" = inv."Id" AND cs."Deleted" = 0
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.TRADINGAUTHORIZATION ta ON ta."InvestorId" = inv."Id" AND ta."Deleted"  = 0
LEFT JOIN FIMS_NEW.TRADINGREPRESENTATIVE tr ON tr."ID" = ta."TradingRepresentativeId" AND tr."DELETED"  = 0
WHERE inv."Deleted" = 0
ORDER BY inv."Id", cs."SecId";
